name: Xinjiang Lixin Energy Co., LTD.
summary: Xinjiang Lixin Energy Co., LTD. engages in the development and conversion of renewable energy sources into electricity in the People's Republic of China. It is involved in wind, photovoltaic, and solar power generation; provision of energy storage power stations and technical consulting services; investment and asset management; electricity and heat production and supply industry; electrical machinery and equipment manufacturing; and research and experimental development. The company was founded in 2013 and is based in Xinjiang, the People's Republic of China.
